title: Vibrant Sisig Tacos
description: A fusion of Filipino sisig and Mexican flavors, these vibrant tacos are a flavorful twist on traditional Mexican street food.
instructions: Heat a pan over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tbsp of flaxseed and toast until fragrant.
Add sisig and cook until lightly browned.
Add filipino vinegar, herbal salsa, and vibrant cilantro. Stir to combine.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by spooning sisig mixture onto tortillas and topping with sliced avocado and a squeeze of lime juice.
